admission.justification: Spans knowledge_impact.py, knowledge_search.py, records_batch.py, marks_compact.py, and knowledge_queries.py, is guarded by five focused contract tests, and delivers bounded drafting and verification retrieval in one MCP surface.

applicability: Drafting and verification queries served by knowledge_read views impact, search, records, and dependent (compact=true).
conditions: impact deduplicates and groups invariants by family with guarantees, 1-line out-of-scope familySiblings, weaknesses, dependents, 80-word statement trims, compact mode, and multi-page continuation inside <= 3,500 tokens.
search runs ix_fts over default invariant/family/weakness kinds, rejects history, supports files/folder scoping, surfaces termsMatched, and trims statements > 80 words inside <= 3,500 tokens.
records fetches up to 25 requested recordIds verbatim without statement trimming at up to 20 records per page inside the 5,000-token bound, naming bounded staleAnchors inline whenever stale > 0.

dependent with compact=true projects rows with aggregated conditionTask/conditionFile, 10-char confirmedCommit, confirmedUncommitted, and movedLinks count, omitting 40-char blob hashes and movingCommitUnknown prose.
exclusions: All four query shapes are strictly read-only and never modify records, sidecars, or derived briefs.
statement: knowledge_read serves bounded impact, search, verbatim batch records (with inline staleAnchors when stale > 0), and compact dependent views that satisfy their token budgets and field contracts.
title: knowledge_read serves bounded impact, search, records, compact dependent
